rules.title: NOC & Statutory Certificate Validity Horizon
rules.description: State Government NOC and Affiliating University NOC must be valid for the current academic year 2026-27. Unexpired status must be corroborated with the state gazette or issuing registry.

rules.title: Central Computer Center Norms (Chapter VII, Table 7.1)
rules.description: Institutions with sanctioned intake ≥ 240 must maintain a minimum of 60 operational PCs with Core i5/equivalent, licensed software, and structured networking in designated lab. Photographic evidence subjected to Cross-Modal Computer Vision verification.

rules.title: Land Ownership & Registered Lease Period
rules.description: The institution premises must be on owned land or registered lease deed for a minimum unbroken period of 30 years (with at least 20 years unexpired at time of scrutiny).

rules.title: Fire & Life Safety Certificate (FSC)
rules.description: Mandatory valid Building & Fire Safety Certificate issued by State Fire Services or Municipal Authority. Stamp and certificate numbers must match the issuing department's online repository.

rules.title: Anti-Ragging & Capitation Fee Undertaking (Clause 4.2)
rules.description: Every EoA application requires a registered affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Rs. 100/-) containing statutory clauses: Anti-Ragging, zero capitation fee, and authentic faculty roster.
mandatoryClauses: Clause 4.2.1: Prevention and Prohibition of Ragging
Clause 4.2.4: Strict Adherence to Prescribed Tuition Fee Structure
